claim_text: Praying over Venezuela's oil and the attacks planned against it, he sees the decks blowing up and fire on the deck, a retaliation, with the drug lords coming against the oil.
quote: I SEE THE DECKS BLOWING UP. I SEE FIRE
falsify_match: Attacks on Venezuelan oil platforms or tankers by cartel groups.
falsify_miss: None. Drug lords attacking oil infrastructure would be a departure from their usual methods.

claim_text: Tunnels with railroad cars moving a secret weapon underneath the ground in Iran on flatbeds, with a cave part filled with water, and something like a wooden boxcar cut off.
quote: They're moving this this secret weapon underneath the ground in Iran
falsify_match: An underground rail system found moving Iranian weapons.
falsify_miss: None found. Iran has displayed underground missile tunnels publicly, which is the base rate.

claim_text: They are regrouping and bringing them to one location closer to Israel and to the water, through a network of ground tunnels a hundred miles or more, some more stable than others because of the terrain.
quote: long stretch of of ground tunnels that would go for I would say 100 miles
falsify_match: A hundred mile tunnel network found running west toward Israel.
falsify_miss: None found. The length is the specific part and could be shown or refuted.

claim_text: He calls it exposed and diffused, that they will not get it out of the ground and it will not be used against any of the boats or against Israel, and says this is not entertainment because what he sees is very serious.
quote: they will not get that out of the ground
falsify_match: The weapon never used.
falsify_miss: It is used. He declares against the outcome he has just described, as he does throughout.

claim_text: Praying over Israeli and American intelligence that the hand of the Lord would rid them of the weapons of mass destruction, with a great revival springing forth, against the antisemitism and persecution he sees coming like a Hitler spirit released upon the world.
quote: It's like a a Hitler uh spirit that would try to be released
falsify_match: A worldwide surge in antisemitic persecution.
falsify_miss: None. Incidents have been at record highs since 2023, so the rise had already happened.

claim_text: It will be so pronounced that you see who stands with Israel and who does not, the nations rise against her, Ezekiel 38 and 39 comes out of this, and the hand of the Lord is shown strong on behalf of the Jewish people.
quote: And Ezekiel 38 and 39 will come out of this
falsify_match: A coalition war against Israel matching the Ezekiel description.
falsify_miss: None. He ties the prophesied war directly to the current conflict, which dates it more than usual.

claim_text: It will look like enemies on all sides, and a people who have never seen God defend them will see it as the children of Israel did coming out of Egypt, rejoicing in the streets because the Lord became real to them in this generation, and he says a major sign is about to be seen.
quote: You're about to see a major sign. Remember this
falsify_match: An event in Israel read nationally as divine intervention.
falsify_miss: None. A major sign is not defined, which is what keeps it from failing.

claim_text: Be patient with the babies coming in quickly, because major events will shake this nation and when it is shaken the people come in from everywhere in droves, more than after September 11th, and the nations will be shaken too.
quote: Major events will take place to shake this nation
falsify_match: A surge in church attendance following a national crisis.
falsify_miss: None. The post September 11th surge lasted about two months, which is the benchmark he chose.

claim_text: He says the Lord told him this happened in Hawaii once, that America has been protected and shielded and nothing has ever happened on its soil like this, and calls it a shaking to awaken the church.
quote: The Lord said this happened in Hawaii once
falsify_match: An emergency alert of that kind on the mainland.
falsify_miss: None. The 2018 Hawaii false missile alert is the obvious referent.

claim_text: The message went out to everybody's phones telling them to go to a certain place, and the Lord said like Hawaii, and he speaks of the responsibility of giving exactly what he is told without holding back, while saying there are certain things he has been told not to relay yet.
quote: But this was everybody's phones
falsify_match: A nationwide emergency alert directing people somewhere.
falsify_miss: None. He also says here that some of what he sees is deliberately withheld.

claim_text: He says he told them to pray over the Supreme Court decision because it would be another domino and what came next was war, that he saw Israel strike first with the president wanting diplomacy and the Israeli prime minister wanting to push the button, and antisemitism reaching an all-time high.
quote: I saw Israel strike first and I've got the videos
falsify_match: The earlier recordings show Israel striking first before it happened.
falsify_miss: They do not, or they came after the escalation was already public.

claim_text: Many people leave New York and other places to come back to Israel, needing finances, with ministries needed to bring them home, amid great antisemitism, protest and riots, and then the 250th anniversary and the instruction to pray over Easter after Ramadan.
quote: there'll be so many people leave New York and other places
falsify_match: A large emigration of American Jews to Israel.
falsify_miss: None. Aliyah from America has run in the low thousands a year for decades.

claim_text: Barren land and complete drought in the farmlands of Oklahoma and around Texas with Altus named, and what they try to control and manipulate will backfire and be stronger than they anticipated, because they yield the weather as a weapon of war and manipulate economies and atmospheres.
quote: what they try to control and manipulate will backfire on them
falsify_match: Severe drought in those areas, or a storm exceeding forecasts.
falsify_miss: Normal conditions. Backfiring covers a storm being worse than expected either way.

claim_text: There will be a loss of control at times, and the Lord warned about the drought, with a press conference about desalination plants for Texas, because the water there becomes so scarce it will be like a dust bowl in the days ahead.
quote: it would be uh like a dust bowl in the days ahead
falsify_match: Dust bowl conditions across Texas farmland.
falsify_miss: None. The 1930s dust bowl is the benchmark he chose, which would be unmistakable.

claim_text: Reading that embassy staff in Israel have been told to leave, he says the Lord showed a great deal about Iran's retaliation and that he thought it would happen in the last twenty four hours because the pulse was so strong, but adds that a pulse that feels immediate can be days or weeks away.
quote: I really believe I thought it was going to happen in the last 24 hours
falsify_match: The retaliation coming inside that window.
falsify_miss: It does not. He concedes here that the intensity of the pulse does not fix the timing, which is the honest note against his own standard.

claim_text: The Secretary of State is dealing on it at a very high level, Cuba has no money, no oil and no food and badly wants American help, and he believes a regime change is coming to Cuba.
quote: I believe a regime change is coming to Cuba
falsify_match: A change of government in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. The economic description is read from the news rather than seen.

claim_text: He plays the president's address saying the military is undertaking a massive operation to destroy Iran's missiles, raze its missile industry to the ground and annihilate its navy.
quote: We are going to annihilate their navy
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the address is not counted as a word.

claim_text: Teaching on living by faith, that if you cannot believe God for a hurting toenail or for five dollars you will not believe him for more if the economy goes bad, and noting that sixty per cent of those polled had no idea who a named Bible teacher was.
quote: If you don't have faith enough to believe him for $5
falsify_match: Nothing. Teaching.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: The address continues, saying the terrorist proxies will no longer destabilise the region or use roadside bombs against Americans, and that Iran will never obtain a nuclear weapon.
quote: They will never have a nuclear weapon
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim.

claim_text: The address tells the Revolutionary Guard and the police to lay down their weapons for complete immunity or face certain death, and tells the people of Iran that the hour of their freedom is at hand and to stay sheltered.
quote: the hour of your freedom is at hand
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim.

claim_text: The address tells the Iranian people that when it is finished they should take over their government because it will be theirs to take and this is probably their only chance for generations, with America backing them with overwhelming force.
quote: When we are finished, take over your government
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded because the whole Iran liberation sequence rests on this address.

claim_text: Teaching that with only twenty five dollars left in the account and three children you must trust God, being fully persuaded rather than merely a believer, as a tither and a giver.
quote: But there's only $25 left in the account
falsify_match: Nothing. Teaching.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: Turkey, Syria and Damascus in the next couple of days with Turkey retaliating and turning it into a powder keg, and praying over Egypt and an attack against Israel coming out of that area.
quote: praying over an attack against Israel coming out of that area
falsify_match: An attack on Israel launched from Egypt.
falsify_miss: None. Egypt has held a peace treaty with Israel since 1979, which is what would have to break.

claim_text: Specific instruction to pray over the Mediterranean and the battleships, and over the payloads of biological weapons he keeps seeing that spray a mustard-looking gas on the troops and on Israeli civilians, though he says he is not a war expert and sees in part.
quote: trying to spray this mustard-looking gas on our troops
falsify_match: A chemical attack on American forces or Israeli civilians.
falsify_miss: None. Delivery by payload spray is the specific mechanism he names.

claim_text: Praying over the buildings and hotels on the Chicago riverfront where he saw two buildings, over subways and mass transit, and over the water supply and water plants, recalling that he gave the figure twenty four million and the eagle in a mass attack against the waterways specifically on the Gulf Coast.
quote: a mass attack against our waterways. Our water plants
falsify_match: An attack on American water treatment plants.
falsify_miss: None. The twenty four million figure is the specific part and is repeated from an earlier telling.

claim_text: Three terrorist men coming out of the Mexican border area into America in a van, with detailed visions of evil men already in the nation, which he insists are not terrorists but an invasion like a Trojan horse, a foreign nation declaring war, a D-Day coming on the shore, a Red Dawn experience.
quote: This is an invasion like Trojan horse of a foreign nation
falsify_match: An organised armed incursion rather than isolated plots.
falsify_miss: None. He raises the bar himself from terrorism to invasion, which makes it harder to satisfy.

claim_text: Concerning Cuba and the Mexican president and the trafficking, the Lord keeps saying do not underestimate your enemy, with a retaliation of things coming from Cuba which they come against, while the liberating is causing a window for Iran to have a major revival.
quote: Don't underestimate your enemy
falsify_match: Cuban retaliation against American interests.
falsify_miss: None. Cuba has not attacked American territory in its history.

claim_text: He recalls saying the prince of Persia had a hold of Iraq and was losing his grip because Iran was about to go down, and that when he loses his grip the pink currency will take off with palm trees and things taking off.
quote: the pink currency will take off and I saw palm trees
falsify_match: A revaluation of the Iraqi currency.
falsify_miss: None. The pink currency is the recurring image and would be settled by any revaluation.

claim_text: Pleading the blood over the navy and calling against any uprising from Russia or China that would escalate into a greater war, that cool heads will prevail, and then he says he sees North Korea and sees Kim.
quote: We call any kind of uprising from Russia or China
falsify_match: Russian or Chinese entry into the conflict.
falsify_miss: None. Cool heads prevailing is the outcome he prays for and the one that would look like an answer.

claim_text: A storm, and all the ships together with two named American aircraft carriers, which he says are the boats he saw would attack Iran in the days ahead, with instruction to pray over the military bases in Kuwait and Baghdad.
quote: The boats I saw that we would attack Iran in the days ahead
falsify_match: Those two carriers taking part in strikes on Iran.
falsify_miss: They do not. Naming the vessels makes this checkable against deployment records.

claim_text: Praying a hedge and a gold dome around Taiwan, he hears them asking whether to push it and go now while America is so distracted with the Middle East, and says conversations and chatter are happening right now.
quote: COULD WE TAKE TAIWAN RIGHT NOW?
falsify_match: A Chinese move on Taiwan while America is engaged in the Middle East.
falsify_miss: None. Right now is the tightest timing he has put on the Taiwan material.

claim_text: Bottles half full and sloshing on the sides of something, spraying and releasing a fog on the people, with a plan coming out of Damascus and Turkey and Syria coming together against Israel, and instruction to pray over Jordan's airspace against another biological attack in the night.
quote: I saw a a a plan coming out of Damascus again
falsify_match: A chemical attack on Israel routed through Jordanian airspace.
falsify_miss: None. Naming the airspace is the specific part.

claim_text: Secret weapons given to Iran arriving on major planes in the middle of the night under a friendly cover, huge transports of the kind used to carry tanks and military equipment.
quote: that were coming on major planes in the middle of the night
falsify_match: Night transport flights delivering weapons to Iran.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he needs help relaying it accurately and is not a war expert.

claim_text: South Korea raises its voice loudly saying no in our region, Japan the same as strategic allies, and Australia stands on that side saying no, all concerning Taiwan, and this is why Hawaii matters.
quote: South Korea say no in our region
falsify_match: Those three states publicly opposing a move on Taiwan.
falsify_miss: They stay quiet. This contradicts his own telling that the allies were only fussy and did not resist.

claim_text: Two of those huge planes flying into Iran together to give them special weapons to defend against America, delivered by China more than once, containing a wooden crate holding a communication device that sends a signal to a satellite which somehow produces an electromagnetic pulse, though not permanently.
quote: it sends some kind of electric magnetic pulse out of it
falsify_match: Chinese delivery of an electronic warfare system to Iran.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Naming China as the supplier is the checkable part.

claim_text: On Cuba and the regime change he saw a dog backed into a corner, with the family who have been dictators there since the 1960s, and a new type of what he calls a Hiroshima.
quote: I saw this man backed into a corner
falsify_match: A desperate Cuban retaliation as the government falls.
falsify_miss: None. Backed into a corner is the framing he uses to explain why a weak state would strike.

claim_text: A new Japan experiment like when the atom bomb was dropped, with a surprise retaliatory attack coming out of Cuba on the basis that they have lost everything and will go down in a blaze of glory, though he believes prayer can change it.
quote: And I'm going down with the blaze of glory
falsify_match: A Cuban attack using an unconventional weapon.
falsify_miss: None. Cuba has no known nuclear capability, which is what would have to be shown.

claim_text: A weapon given to them by Russia which he says to remember, round with a biohazard symbol on the side, one thing and under the ground, which he saw coming up out of the ground and being used in the days ahead.
quote: I saw a weapon given to them by Russia
falsify_match: A Russian-supplied unconventional weapon found in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None found. The biohazard marking is the identifying detail.

claim_text: A man with very nice hair rising up with revival breaking out in Mexico, though the Lord says the church will have to contend and pray for it because it will not just happen, with revival also breaking out in Venezuela, Colombia and Cuba.
quote: you will have to contend, church, and pray for this
falsify_match: That man rising and church growth following in Mexico.
falsify_miss: Neither. It will not just happen means an absence is laid at the church's door.

claim_text: Something occultic being summoned around this man, and a satanic stronghold that has been over the whole island of Cuba which the Lord is bringing down, coming down also over Venezuela and Colombia.
quote: There has been a satanic stronghold
falsify_match: Nothing observable on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. This is the earliest telling of the Cuban stronghold coming down.

claim_text: The valley of decision is running and this looks like the first phases of liberating Iran, with the question of what he does in the days ahead, whether he stands with Israel, and what happens with a Jonathan and David relationship.
quote: The valley of decisions will be the make or break
falsify_match: A decisive break either way on standing with Israel.
falsify_miss: None. Make or break is not tied to any measurable outcome.

claim_text: The stronghold comes down over Mexico too, with a great revival all over South America and a flood of his presence bringing the greatest harvest of souls, and brand new sanctions being lifted with economic growth coming around the island.
quote: I saw a brand new sanctions being lift of economic growth
falsify_match: American sanctions on Cuba lifted.
falsify_miss: They are not. Sanctions relief is a concrete act that would be reported.

claim_text: They do not want to give things away, and the Lord says not to underestimate the enemy or think you are the big one in the schoolyard because you have the best army and intelligence, but to be humble and not look at them as weak, because they have a surprise.
quote: Don't look at them as they're weak. They have a surprise
falsify_match: An unexpected Cuban capability revealed.
falsify_miss: None revealed. The surprise is named but never described here.

claim_text: The surprise is the device he saw, and he says this man will try to go out fighting and not to believe everything you hear, but that it can be stopped, peace can be made and the people of Cuba can be liberated, as also Venezuela and Brazil.
quote: they will try to go out fighting this man
falsify_match: A last stand by the Cuban leadership using that device.
falsify_miss: None. Do not believe everything you hear covers a reported death or departure being false.

claim_text: In Mexico the cartel gets three new leaders and then more, with territorial wars coming as one leader is taken out by another and groups claim turf across parts of Mexico, and the same happening in Venezuela and spreading.
quote: I saw territorial wars coming to the cartel
falsify_match: A succession war among Mexican cartels after leadership removals.
falsify_miss: None. Cartel succession violence is a documented pattern, which is the base rate this would have to exceed.
